title: Register a business for payroll tax
summary: This page provides information on how to register a business for payroll tax.
intro:
Payroll tax is a tax for employers. It is based on the amount of monthly wages paid to permanent, temporary and casual employees and certain contractors.

The payroll tax threshold determines at what point employers must pay the payroll tax. Each state and territory has its own payroll tax threshold.

You can register for payroll tax online.
who_can_apply: Employers who pay wages to permanent, temporary, and casual employees and certain contractors.
Businesses must pay monthly if payments to employees exceed $20,000.
Businesses can pay annually if payments to employees are $20,000 or less.
what_you_need: Your address, contact, and bank details.
The date your business first employed staff.
All payments to employees for the current year, plus the 4 previous years (if applicable).

faqs.a: Payroll tax is a tax for employers, based on the amount of monthly wages paid to permanent, temporary, and casual employees and certain contractors.

faqs.q: How is the payroll tax threshold determined?
faqs.a: The payroll tax threshold determines when employers must pay the tax. Each state and territory has its own threshold.

faqs.q: When must I pay payroll tax?
faqs.a: If your payments to employees are more than $20,000, you must pay monthly. If they are $20,000 or less, you can pay annually.
